dedupe_keys.name: entur netex to gtfs java converter

description: Entur publishes this Java library to convert NeTEx public-transport data into GTFS schedule archives. The input consists of a provider codespace, timetable data and complete definitions of the referenced StopPlaces and Quays. The default converters expect the Nordic NeTEx Profile; extension interfaces allow a developer to replace data loading or entity production for another profile. Geographic coverage, calendar dates and timing resolution are determined by the input datasets. The documented Java API accepts streams and returns a stream for the output ZIP archive. Source code is public and free under EUPL 1.2. Conversion has a stated semantic limitation: NeTEx can override mode at individual ServiceJourney level, whereas the GTFS conversion retains the Line-level mode for a route. Unsupported profiles and incomplete stop definitions therefore need explicit handling. Simulation uses include preparing timetable inputs for route planning and multimodal network analysis. The converter relates to data-transmodel-netex-siri-standards, data-gtfs-specification and model-opentripplanner. The review read the interface documentation and repository metadata; it did not execute a conversion or establish lossless round-trip behaviour.
name: Entur NeTEx-to-GTFS Java converter
